description: Generate the pre-flight (before design) or post-flight (before ship) checklist for one user flow. Returns the checklist as structured items (each tied to a principle) and as ready-to-paste markdown. Use it to review a design or a pull request against the flow it implements.

flow_id.description: The flow id. One of: "onboarding", "forms", "pricing", "dashboard", "empty-states", "checkout", "settings", "navigation", "search", "authentication", "notifications", "data-tables". Call list_flows for the current set.

locale.description: Language of the returned content: "en" (English) or "es" (Spanish). Defaults to "en".

phase.description: Which checklist to generate: "preflight" (before design) or "postflight" (before ship).

name: generate_checklist
title: Generate a flow checklist
